# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `vori` MCP server pointing at VoriOS's hosted endpoint (`https://mcp.vori.com`).
- Auth uses Vori user sign-in — no API key to configure.
- Logo: Vori mark from the `voriteam` GitHub organization avatar, 256×256.
